Market Traction: For non-healthcare or life science companies, your product or service should have a solid number of customers and traction in Germany.
Healthcare and life science companies should demonstrate a high unmet or under-met market need for the proposed solution.

Runway: Startups with sufficient funding, usually for the next 6 to 9 months (usually Seed or Series A as well as extended Series A, Series B, and C) are ready for our programs in the U.S. and Asia, as well as for the Life Sciences program.
